'''Adrian Verana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[The Traitor's Gambit]]'' describes Verana as having jet-black hair and a beard, an image of him in [[A Wretched Hive (adventure)|''A Wretched Hive'']] depicts him with brown hair and a clean-shaven face.
